The Campaign Registry (TCR) has introduced a new brand identity verification process for Public Profit entities. The primary objective of Authentication+ is to help prevent brand impersonation, which can lead to consumer fraud that includes disinformation, smishing, and spoofing. Webex Connect will be aligning to the new Authentication+ process of TCR. 

## 🚧
Note

All publicly traded companies must begin using the additional 2FA process (Authentication+) starting October 17, 2024 to be Auth+ compliant, and existing brands must achieve Auth+ compliance by October 30, 2025.

## 📘
Note:

Self-serve campaign creation is currently disabled on the 10DLC module of Webex Connect. To create new campaigns, please reach out to the Support Team after your brand achieves Authentication+ compliant. Follow the procedures below to achieve Auth+ compliant.

## 

Existing Brands

### 

Reviewing the Authentication+ Status

Procedure to review the Authentication+ status of your brand.

Steps:

- 

Log in to the Webex Connect platform.

- 

Click Assets > 10DLC. 

 [Image: Screenhot of the navigating to Assets >10DLC page.] 
Assets>10DLC Navigation

- 

On the Brands & Campaigns (10DLC) page, view the Auth+ Status column to review the current authentication status of the profit entity types.

 [Image: Screenshot of Brand& Campaigns(10DLC) displaying Auth+ Status] 
Brands & Campaigns (10DLC) Page with Auth+ Status

## 📘
Note:

The Auth+ Status column is only applicable for Public Profit entity types. For the rest of the brand types, you will see N/A.

The possible statuses are:

- Non-compliant: Displays when your brand is not Auth+ compliant and the business email of your brand is not verified.

- Pending: Displays when the brand’s Auth+ compliance verification process is underway.

- Active: Displays when your brand’s Auth+ compliance is verified and active.

- Renewal Pending: Displays when your brand's Auth+ compliance is about to expire.

- Expired: Displays when your brand’s Auth+ compliance verification lapses.

- Failed: Displays when your brand’s Auth+ compliance verification fails.

For more information on the possible statuses, please refer to the FAQ  What are the possible status types, and what actions should be taken for each? section.

### 

Making the Existing Brands Authentication+ Compliant

Procedure to update an existing brand to make it Auth+ Complaint.

Steps:

- 

Log in to the Webex Connect platform.

- 

Click Assets > 10DLC.

 [Image: Screenshot of navigating to Assets>10DLC page.] 
Assets >10DLC Navigation

- 

On the Brands & Campaigns (10DLC) page, click Manage Action for a specific brand record in the brand listing table.

 [Image: Screenshot to Manage a Brand record on the Brand Listing page.] 
Manage a Brand record on the Brand Listing Page 

## 📘
The 'Manage' option

If the 'Manage' option is disabled, it means your brand was initially created through a support process. Please contact the Webex Connect Support Team to get the email address updated and the 2FA process initiated.

- 

Click Edit Details.

- 

In the Manage Brand form > Company Contact & Address section > in the Business Email Address field, add or update Business Email Address for your associated brand.

 [Image: Screenshot of Manage Brand Form >Company Contact & Address Section to update the correct business email address,] 
Manage Brand Form > Company Contact & Address Section

- 

Click Save the form for verification. You will receive an email regarding 2FA from TCR (Received from noreply@auth.campaignregistry.com).

- 

Complete verification by following the steps provided in the email received from TCR.

 [Image: Screenshot of the Sample email to complete email address verification] 
Sample Email to Complete Email Address Verification

### 

Renewing Authentication+ for your Brands

Procedure to renew brand authentication with pending and expired Auth+ Status.

Steps 

- 

Log in to the Webex Connect platform.

- 

Click Assets > 10DLC.

 [Image: Screenshot of navigating to Assets > 10DLC page. ] 
Assets >10DLC Navigation

- 

To Renew a Brand with Pending Auth+ Status: 

- 

On the Brands & Campaigns (10DLC) page, in the Action column, click the drop-down button and select Renew Auth+ for any pending brand record in the brand listing table.

 [Image: Screenshot of Renew Auth+ option for a pending Auth+status record on the brand listing page.] 
Brand Listing Page with Renew Auth+ option for a Pending Auth+ Status Record

- 

Click Confirm  to initiate authentication renewal.

 [Image: Screenshot of confirming to initiate a new Auth+ process.] 
Confirm to Initiate a new Auth+ process

- 

To Renew a Brand with Expired Auth+ Status:

- 

On the Brands & Campaigns (10DLC) page, in the Action column, click the drop-down button and select Renew Auth+ for any expired brand record in the brand listing table.

 [Image: Screenshot of Brand Listing page with Renew Auth+ option for a Expired Auth+ Status record.] 
Brand Listing Page with Renew Auth+ option for a Expired Auth+ Status Record

- 

Click Confirm to initiate authentication renewal.

 [Image: Screenshot of confirming to initiate a new Auth+ process.] 
Confirm to Initiate a new Auth+ process

- 

You will receive an email regarding 2FA from TCR (Received from noreply@auth.campaignregistry.com).

- 

Complete verification by following the steps provided in the email received from TCR.

###

Procedure to resend the authentication email to yourself incase you don’t find it in your inbox.

Steps:

- 

Log in to the Webex Connect platform.

- 

Click Assets > 10DLC.

 [Image: Screenshot of navigating to Assets>10DLC page.] 
Assets >10DLC Navigation

- 

On the Brands & Campaigns (10DLC) page, in the Action column, click the drop-down button and select Resend Auth+ Email for any pending brand record in the brand listing table.

 [Image: Screenshot of Brand Listing page with Resend Auth+ Email option for a expired Brand Auth+ Status record.] 
Brand Listing page with Resend Auth+ Email option

## 

Registering New Brands

- In the Create New Brand page > Company Contact & Address section, in the Business Email Address field, add a valid email address matching the brand or organizations domain while filling in the Brand Registration form. For example, an actual email address of the brand representative should be used. Format:  'nicole@acmecorp.com'.

- Click Create. You will receive an email regarding 2FA from TCR (Received from noreply@auth.campaignregistry.com).

You must complete the 2FA process by clicking the link in the email received in the Inbox from TCR.

 [Image: Creating a Brand] 
Creating a Brand

You can start creating a Campaign only after the authentication+ process is completed and your Brand is verified.

## 

FAQ's

### 

How do I review my current status?

Navigate to the Auth+ Status column on the Brand Listing page to view the dedicated column displaying the Auth+ status for each brand. For more information, please refer to the Reviewing the Authentication+ Status  section.

## 

What are the possible status types, and what actions should be taken for each?

 | Auth+ Status | Description | Recommended Action

 | Non-compliant | No verified business email on form. | Edit the brand, add a valid business email, and submit for verification.

 | Pending | Verification is underway. | Await completion of the verification process; no action needed unless prompted.

 | Active | Auth+ is current and verified. | No action needed; your brand is fully compliant.

 | Expired | Auth+ verification has lapsed. | Click the 'Renew Auth+' button and complete the re-verification process to restore compliance.

 | Renewal Pending | Auth+ verification about to expire | Click the 'Renew Auth+' button and complete the re-verification process to restore compliance.

 | Failed | Verification did not succeed. | A support ticket is automatically generated; await outreach from support or respond if contacted.

### 

What should I do to be Auth+ compliant?

For most legacy brands, the initial status is Non-compliant. Brand owners edit the brand, add a valid business email, and submit it for verification to make it Auth+ compliant. This process follows industry standards for business verification, like those on platforms like Google My Business and Facebook Business Manager. For more information, please refer to the Making the Existing Brands Authentication+ Compliant section.

### 

What should I do to renew my Auth+ if the renewal is pending or expired?

If Auth+ status is nearing expiry or already expired, brand owners will see a ‘Renew Auth+’ option for periodic re-verification to maintain up-to-date records. For more information, please refer to the Renewing the Authentication+ for your Brands section.

### 

Do I get an alert if the Brand Auth+ is about to expire or has expires?

If Auth+ status is nearing expiry or already expired, brand owners and tenant owners will receive and an email from the Webex Connect platform with the guidance on the next steps. 

### 

I am not able to see the email, what should I do?

During the verification process, if the brand owner doesn’t receive the email, there’s an option to resend the two-factor authentication (2FA) email. For more information, please refer to the Resending the Authentication+ Email section.

### 

What should I do, when my email verification fails?

If verification fails, a support ticket is automatically generated and sent to our PSG team, who will proactively reach out to resolve the issue.

### 

What are the guidelines for adding the Business email address?

Please refer to the following guidelines for adding the Business email addresses:

- Please add a valid email matching the brand or organizations' domain during brand registration.

- Ensure that the email is not a group or alias email such as sales@brand.com, support@brand.com. The correct input would be a brand representative's email ID representing the brand.

This change is currently applicable to only Public Traded Entity Types and will be rolled out for other Entity Types in the future. 

TCR will refund the cost incurred in reverting existing Public Profit brands with a 'VERIFIED' or 'VETTED_VERIFIED' identity status that choose to go through Authentication+ verification.

### 

What are the different failures associated with 2FA verification?

The following error codes are associated with 2FA verification failures:

 | Error Code | Message | Description | Recommended Action

 | 21736 | Domain Ownership Could Not Be Verified | The domain associated with the brand contact email could not be validated. | Use an email domain clearly tied to your brand. Contact our support team if you believe your domain should qualify.

 | 21737 | 2FA Verification Expired | The 2FA authentication link or token expired before it was used. | Re-do the steps mentioned in Making the Existing Brands Authentication+ Compliant section.

 | 21738 | 2FA Email Undeliverable | The verification email failed to reach the brand contact because the email address or domain was invalid. | Ensure the email address is correct, active, and can receive external messages. Update the contact email if needed.

 | 21739 | 2FA Verification Failed or Timed Out | The verification process failed to complete successfully. | Re-do the steps mentioned in Making the Existing Brands Authentication+ Compliant section.

 | 21740 | Invalid Brand Contact Email Domain | The domain used in the brand contact email is not supported for Auth+ verification. (e.g., gmail.com or yahoo.com etc). | Use a business or organizational email domain associated with your brand. Avoid free or generic email providers.

 | 21741 | 2FA Code Expired | The verification code expired before it was entered | Re-do the steps mentioned in Making the Existing Brands Authentication+ Compliant section.
